title: openai-python 3.0.0 Drops certifi for the OS Trust Store
caption:
A major version bump that changes your TLS trust store is a rough way to start the week.

openai 3.0.0 landed Aug 12. It swaps httpx for httpx2, and certifi is no longer installed — verification now goes through your operating system's trust store instead.

Slim containers and TLS-inspecting proxies are the ones that break. Your code doesn't change at all, which is exactly what makes it easy to miss.

Do you pin your SDK versions?

slides.headline:
openai 3.0
dropped certifi
slides.sub: Shipped Aug 12. TLS now verifies against your OS trust store, not the certifi bundle.

slides.title: Where it bites
items: Slim containers with no system CA certificates
Deployments that patched the certifi bundle
Code that imported httpx via openai

slides.title: One env var
slides.sub: Set SSL_CERT_FILE to a CA bundle path. Or install system CA certs in the image.
